description: The plot titled “Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset” illustrates how three evaluation metrics (Precision, Recall, and F1-score) vary across five model configurations in an ablation setting. The x-axis is categorical (no numeric scale) with five labels: “Full model (Ours),” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation,” shown left to right with rotated tick labels. The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 56 to 66 with regularly spaced tick marks at 58, 60, 62, 64, and 66. Three solid lines with circular markers are shown: Precision is a purple line that starts at 65.45 for “Full model (Ours),” drops to 61.06 at “w/o Prompt,” rises to 62.22 at “w/o Augmentation,” then increases to 64.06 at “w/o Attention,” and ends at 65.44 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” Recall is a blue line that starts at 65.78, decreases to 59.64 at “w/o Prompt,” increases to 63.75 at “w/o Augmentation,” then declines to 59.17 at “w/o Attention,” and ends at 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” F1-score is a tan/brown line that starts at 65.56, drops to 60.16 at “w/o Prompt,” rises to 62.63 at “w/o Augmentation,” then decreases to 59.67 at “w/o Attention,” and ends at 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.”
